request: change 7 day launch requirement to 6 hour, unless there's a good reason not to. how do we move on from here
rationale: Use the client's chosen Neon Free plan at launch. The shorter recovery history is an accepted launch tradeoff: corruption or deletion discovered after six hours may be unrecoverable.
providerLimit: Neon Free advertises six hours, capped at 1 GB of change history. The actual oldest recoverable time must be recorded; configuration alone cannot prove six hours of available history. No paid upgrade is authorized.
preservedConstraints: Four-hour operational recovery-time target and dated non-production restore drill before launch.
LEG-12 deletion/revocation replay, quarantine, and fail-closed recovery; controls remain retained until all capable backups expire plus seven days.
SYS-11 production, preview, local, and recovery isolation; previews use synthetic data.
Honest recovery-point granularity and last recoverable time; no promise of zero data loss.
All other source requirements, release tiers, and preview cleanup deadlines.

replacements.before: Set a production recovery window of at least seven days and an operational recovery-time target of four hours for this launch.
replacements.after: Set a production recovery window of at least six hours and an operational recovery-time target of four hours for this launch.
